Prevent infinite loops, exponential traversal, and large memory bloat when loading legacy wallets
reviewability: Ready for review; no known blockers or rework needed
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified bug reproduces on master and resolves here across migration and unit tests (fametrano)
